                                                        window.dtn.futures.createFuturesChartWidget({

                                    const h1 = container.querySelector('div.commodity-title h1');

                                            const span = document.createElement('span');
                                            span.style.color = '#838384';
                                            span.style.fontSize = '0.60em';
                                            span.textContent = '[' + match[2] + ' minute delayed]';
                                            h1.appendChild(span);
                                        }
                                    }
                                };
                                const applyH1Align = () => container.querySelectorAll('h1[class*="options-widget"]').forEach(h1 => {

                                        container.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => {
                                            if (b.textContent.trim() === 'Compact') b.click();
                                        });
                                    }
                                };

                                applyDelayedLabel();
                                applyH1Align();
                                applyCompactActive();
                                const observer = new MutationObserver(() => { applyNoWrap(); applyDelayedLabel(); applyH1Align(); applyCompactActive(); });
